selection: Development only: single_lift_sloth; SoftVTBench task0. Primary target trajectories not scored before freeze.

intervals.secondary_held_grasp: attachment_active sum > 0 from tool width, command, prefix-defined grasp
intervals.secondary_released: frame after prefix-defined grasp and command > 0

scope: Per-sequence prefix fitting; unseen future tool positions, not zero-shot unseen-object prediction.
SoftVTBench: sparse synthetic observed geometry and privileged initial volumetric nodes, not RGB policy success.
PhysTwin: author observed tracks, reconstructed initial geometry, prescribed future controllers.
SoftVT gripper/object transform calibrated on the same sparse prefix nodes at input-defined grasp.
FEM fits quasistatic equilibrium; release adds implicit Euler with inferred effective mass/stiffness ratio.
All methods know initial floor only; newly encountered basket/obstacle geometry is not supplied.
No force or material labels are used. Gravity acceleration for release is the known terrestrial constant.
Material/world ratios are point estimates, not calibrated posteriors.
